technique_name: Explain why businesses should leverage AI
description: Businesses should leverage AI because it can dramatically reduce the time, cost, and resources required to complete tasks. AI-based solutions can learn and improve over time, making them more accurate and efficient than traditional models. This can help with areas such as customer service, predictive analytics, marketing, and decision making by providing deeper insights than human analysis.
